Professional Construction Cleanup Services

Expert post-construction cleanup across Idaho and Utah. From debris removal to final detailing, delivering inspection-ready results.

Comprehensive Construction Cleanup Services

Imperial Cleaning Inc. specializes in professional post-construction cleanup services designed to transform construction sites into pristine, inspection-ready spaces.

Debris Removal

Complete removal of construction materials, packaging, and jobsite debris

Deep Cleaning

Thorough cleaning of all surfaces, fixtures, and hard-to-reach areas

Inspection Ready

Final preparation for occupancy permits and client walkthroughs

Why Choose Our Construction Cleanup?

  • Experienced teams trained in construction site safety protocols
  • Industrial-grade equipment for efficient debris removal and cleaning
  • Coordination with project timelines and contractor schedules
  • Comprehensive insurance coverage and bonding for protection
  • Quality assurance inspections before project completion

Professional Standards

Our 3-Phase Construction Cleanup Process

Our systematic approach ensures thorough, efficient cleanup that meets inspection standards and project deadlines.

1

Phase 1: Rough Cleaning & Assessment

Initial site assessment and removal of major construction debris, materials, and safety hazards.

2

Phase 2: Detailed Cleaning & Surface Preparation

Comprehensive cleaning of all surfaces, fixtures, and systems. Focus on removing construction dust, adhesives, and preparing surfaces for final inspection.

3

Phase 3: Final Inspection & Quality Assurance

Final quality checks, touch-ups, and preparation for client walkthrough or occupancy permit inspection.
